SELECT id, target_ref, detected_at, detected_by, severity, claim_text, falsification, evidence, remediation, status, updated_at FROM internal_errata WHERE target_kind = 'paper' ORDER BY detected_at, id
SELECT day, bot, kind, status, SUM(n) AS n FROM seo_crawl_log WHERE day >= date('now', '-2 days') GROUP BY day, bot, kind, status

SELECT p.slug AS slug, p.title AS title, p.version AS version, p.status AS status, p.last_revised_at AS last_revised_at, pp.provenance AS provenance, pp.reviewed_by AS reviewed_by FROM papers p LEFT JOIN paper_provenance pp ON pp.slug = p.slug WHERE p.status IN ('published', 'distributed', 'external_preprint') AND p.slug IS NOT NULL AND p.slug <> '' ORDER BY p.slug
